{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection2",
  "test_code": "// Copyright (c) All contributors. All rights reserved.\n// Licensed under the MIT license. See LICENSE file in the project root for full license information.\n\nusing System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection2\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task GeneratedFormattersAndResolversHaveExcludeFromCodeCoverage()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TestProject\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class IntKeyObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Id { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public string Name { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(2)]\n        public MyEnum EnumValue { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(3)]\n        public IMyUnion UnionValue { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(true)]\n    public class StringKeyObject\n    {\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n\n        public string Label { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    public enum MyEnum\n    {\n        First,\n        Second,\n    }\n\n    [Union(0, typeof(UnionImplA))]\n    [Union(1, typeof(UnionImplB))]\n    public interface IMyUnion\n    {\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionImplA : IMyUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int A { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionImplB : IMyUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public string B { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80References = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> references = net80References.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePack.SourceGenerator.MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n        Assert.Single(runResult.Results);\n        GeneratorRunResult result = runResult.Results[0];\n        Assert.Null(result.Exception);\n        Assert.Empty(result.Diagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.NotEmpty(result.GeneratedSources);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? excludeAttrSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(typeof(ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute).FullName!);\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeAttrSymbol);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterInterface = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\");\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterInterface);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverInterface = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.IFormatterResolver\");\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverInterface);\n\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> generatedTypes = new();\n        foreach (GeneratedSourceResult generatedSource in result.GeneratedSources)\n        {\n            SemanticModel semanticModel = outputCompilation.GetSemanticModel(generatedSource.SyntaxTree);\n            foreach (TypeDeclarationSyntax typeDecl in generatedSource.SyntaxTree.GetRoot().DescendantNodes().OfType<TypeDeclarationSyntax>())\n            {\n                INamedTypeSymbol? typeSymbol = semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(typeDecl);\n                Assert.NotNull(typeSymbol);\n                generatedTypes.Add(typeSymbol);\n\n                bool hasExcludeFromCodeCoverage = typeSymbol.GetAttributes().Any(\n                    attr => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(attr.AttributeClass, excludeAttrSymbol));\n                Assert.True(\n                    hasExcludeFromCodeCoverage,\n                    $\"Generated type '{typeSymbol.ToDisplayString()}' in '{generatedSource.HintName}' is missing [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        HashSet<string> formattedTargetTypes = generatedTypes\n            .SelectMany(t => t.AllInterfaces)\n            .Where(i => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i.OriginalDefinition, formatterInterface))\n            .Select(i => i.TypeArguments[0].ToDisplayString())\n            .ToHashSet();\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"TestProject.IntKeyObject\", formattedTargetTypes);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TestProject.StringKeyObject\", formattedTargetTypes);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TestProject.MyEnum\", formattedTargetTypes);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TestProject.IMyUnion\", formattedTargetTypes);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TestProject.UnionImplA\", formattedTargetTypes);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TestProject.UnionImplB\", formattedTargetTypes);\n\n        bool hasResolver = generatedTypes.Any(\n            t => t.AllInterfaces.Any(i => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i, resolverInterface)));\n        Assert.True(hasResolver, \"Expected a generated IFormatterResolver type.\");\n    }\n}\n"
}
